edition.tagline: Just the facts. And the food.
edition.cue: Serve dinner when Friday and Streebek go undercover at the PAGAN ceremony.

s.how: Remove the stems from 20 button mushrooms. Mix 150g cream cheese with 2 crushed garlic cloves, 40g parmesan and 30g breadcrumbs. Fill the caps, scatter more crumbs on top and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until golden.

s.note: Friday's desk, all strictly by the book
s.how: Warm 8 glazed doughnuts on a tray at 160C for 2 minutes until the glaze turns glossy again. Serve on a plain plate with paper napkins and a pot of drip coffee made from 60g grounds and 1L water.

m.how: Cut 1.2kg pork shoulder into chunks, rub with cumin, oregano and salt and braise with 1 orange, 3 garlic cloves and 250ml water at 160C for 2.5 hours. Shred, crisp in the pan and serve in 16 corn tortillas with diced onion, coriander and lime.

w.how: Bake 2 sheets puff pastry pricked and weighted at 200C for 15 minutes. Whisk 1L milk, 6 egg yolks, 150g sugar, 90g cornflour and 2 tsp vanilla over medium heat until very thick. Spread between the pastry in a lined tin, chill 4 hours, ice with 200g icing sugar mixed with a little water and cut into squares.

d.how: Brew 60g ground coffee with 1L water in a drip machine. Pour black into plain mugs. When a cup gets low, refill it without saying anything. Just the coffee, nothing else.
